test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Get your act together
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Get organized and work efficiently**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Get your act together"** means to get organized and work efficiently. (संगठित हो जाओ और कुशलतापूर्वक काम करो) • **Example:** You need to get your act together if you want to meet this deadline. • **"Get organized and work efficiently"** refers to the process of arranging tasks and resources in a systematic way to achieve maximum productivity. (संगठित हो जाओ और कुशलतापूर्वक काम करो) • **Example:** To succeed in this project, we need to get organized and work efficiently. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Get organized and work efficiently**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Behave in a rude way** (असभ्य तरीके से व्यवहार करना): • **Example:** He was asked to leave the meeting because he was behaving in a rude way. • **Write a letter** (पत्र लिखना): • **Example:** She decided to write a letter to her old friend to reconnect. • **Speak properly** (सही तरीके से बोलना): • **Example:** The teacher instructed the students to speak properly during the presentation. 141:T878, ```html The correct answer is **Option (4)** i.e. **BACED**
